//: Typecheck the Flow B compiler (aot/). Its .mts files are checked strictly; a .mjs file is read only for the types it exports, unless it opts in with // @ts-check. Node runs the .mts files directly by stripping their types, so only erasable syntax is allowed (no enums, namespaces or parameter properties), a relative import names the real file (./x.mts), and a type-only import is written `import type`. The JavaScript the compiler imports from assets/ and src/ is listed so this project (composite, for the references in tsconfig.json) can read it. Run with `npm run typecheck`.
